name: Roky
summary: Ventkids の Vent Pobbers のリーダー
> “I run the Vent Pobbers, we make the boards. You buyin'? Need a plank? Once a cycle I got somethin' dog. Best prices, too, glinty. Mates rates, chek?”
> Roky is the leader of the Vent Pobbers, a subdivision of the Ventkids gang in Fortuna. She is in charge of selling and assembling K-Drives.
sections: - The K-Drive that Roky is holding is the same as the K-Drive on sale as that day's special. Except, of course, properly dinged and scraped, as befits a proper Pobber!
